reasons: The current data-use decision permits private local analysis but defers cloud fine-tuning and prohibits participant-level external transmission without separate approval.
Only nine decision-eligible development experiments are available, three of which require visual stimuli; their aggregate arm effects are insufficient training data for a meaningful 7B/14B LoRA.
The project plan makes LoRA optional until it serves a specific decision-level hypothesis, and the current prompted suite already has a more urgent prospective confirmation need.
prohibited_actions: upload participant rows or target covariates to Modal or another managed service
train on any of the six confirmation experiments
tune a fine-tune after seeing confirmation outcomes
describe an aggregate-only toy fine-tune as a behavioral simulator
reopen_only_if: a documented data-use decision separately permits the exact training transfer and compute environment
an experiment-level train/validation split with adequate eligible study support is frozen
a decision-level hypothesis and target-excluded cross-fitting plan are prespecified
exact checkpoint, training records, seeds, learning rates, data sizes, cost ceiling, and stopping rules are frozen before execution
